sources.answer:
Use the [Pharos Pacific Mainnet explorer](https://www.pharosscan.xyz) to look up transaction `0xa2d0fd2a0289352badaf4f151c46dfd807de12d7f43b4008f236e4ca7bfe6399`. The explorer is documented for checking transaction status and inspecting blocks and network activity. The [Pacific Mainnet](/getting-started/network/pacific-mainnet) identify the network as **Pharos Pacific Mainnet**, chain ID **1672**, with native ticker **PROS**.

The supplied pages do **not** document a `transaction_receipt` JSON-RPC method, receipt fields, or how to read gas values from a receipt. They also don’t specify whether the explorer displays gas for this transaction. **DOCS\_NOT\_COVERED** for those details, so I can’t confirm whether this transaction succeeded or report its block or gas from the provided documentation.

The [Block Explorer](/tooling-and-infrastructure/block-explorer) also describes contract inspection, but provides no contract-specific assumptions relevant to this transaction.
